title: AI Agent Developer
description: We are looking for an AI Agent Developer to join an innovative technology-driven environment focused on building intelligent automation solutions powered by Generative AI. This is an exciting opportunity to work on the design, development, and optimization of AI agents and automation workflows that streamline business processes, improve efficiency, and deliver tangible business value. Flexible Hybrid model: 2 days per week in the office in Restelo Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain AI agents using platforms such as n8n and similar orchestration tools. Build and optimize AI workflows integrating LLMs, APIs, databases, and enterprise applications . Develop and refine prompts, prompt chains, and agentic workflows to maximize AI performance and reliability. Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions and knowledge-based AI systems. Integrate AI solutions with internal and external platforms through REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and messaging services . Design secure authentication and authorization mechanisms for AI applications and integrations. Monitor AI agent performance, reliability, and operational metrics. Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and governance standards. Document AI workflows, integrations, and operational procedures. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Software Engineers, Architects, and Operations teams to identify and deliver automation opportunities. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, and AI automation concepts . Experience with AI orchestration frameworks and platforms such as: n8n, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Flowise Experience implementing RAG architectures , vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search solutions. Hands-on experience integrating systems through REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and messaging services . Knowledge of authentication and authorization standards including: OAuth2 OpenID Connect, JWT, SAML, API Keys Experience with one or more AI providers such as: Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock Experience with: JavaScript / TypeScript Node.js, Docker, Git & GitHub Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, pgvector, or Azure AI Search. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Professional English proficiency. Nice to have Previous experience with n8n . Experience delivering AI-powered business automation solutions in production environments. Knowledge of insurance, insurtech, claims, or enterprise process automation domains. If you're passionate about AI Agents, Automation, LLMs, and the future of intelligent workflows , we'd love to hear from you.
